component.name: OverDrive
component.description: Amon & Reese knows from years of experience just how hard the military can push their ships. Their OverDrive power plant was designed from the ground up to not only handle those tough conditions with less overheating, but to provide the same dependability and power to civilians as well.

component.name: Winter-Star
component.description: Join the J-Span family by snagging the Winter-Star cooler for your ship. This entry-level model lacks flash but its strong performance record and price point make it a popular choice for pilots across the UEE.

component.name: SecureHyde
component.description: Get extra protection with the SecureHyde shield generator. This military-grade component provides superior durability over every other shield generator in its class.

component.name: Fleming
component.description: The Fleming is WillsOp’s base small radar. What it lacks in bells and whistles, it makes up for with consistent performance.

component.name: Jericho XL
component.description: The Jericho XL rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size three hardpoint and capable of carrying eighteen S1 rockets.

component.name: ComfortAir
component.description: Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

component.name: VariPuck S2 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: CF-227 Badger Repeater
component.description: The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight.
